lines.text: Look at them! Laughing at nothing on a tracking-marker-less green screen!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: They're pantomiming corporate fun. It costs 80% less than genuine joy.

lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: Their keying is terrible. Look at that green spill on their polo collars.
